user_question: Count the hospitals located within each census tract in Centre County.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Count the hospitals located within each census tract in Centre County.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject hospital points to tract CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform hospital point geometries into the projected CRS used by the census tracts so the spatial count can be performed with compatible CRSs.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the hospital vector layer from its observed CRS to EPSG:26918. Preserve the hospital attributes and point geometries.

workflow_steps.title: Count hospitals within each census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Assign the number of hospital points located within each Centre County census tract.
workflow_steps.instructions: Count the reprojected hospital points within the census tract polygons. Retain the tract attributes and write the resulting count to an output field named hospital_count.
